messages:
julia: Incoming pen test from external partner confirmed (2026-01-12). We need a concrete plan for RBAC freeze windows, KMS/HSM interaction rules, and how we deliver evidence (signed bag vs presigned). Who volunteers to own the evidence-bag signing?

omar: Dates and scope? staging only? any partner infra?

julia: Window: 2026-01-12 09:00 -> 2026-01-13 17:00 UTC. Scope: staging + integration cluster. Includes runtime KMS calls, HSM-backed signing, S3 reads, and OAuth flows. No prod.

trent: About KMS/HSM: we will NOT grant decrypt privileges. Provide ciphertext artifacts and a controlled signing/checking endpoint that forwards to HSM for sign/verify only. All HSM calls must be logged with request_id and trace_id.

sec-oncall: I can set up the ephemeral roles. Proposed TTL=3h, OKTA mapping will include assessor email -> principal. Command I'll execute: `./grant-ephemeral --principal assessor:partner --scope staging:read,kms-proxy:sign --ttl 3h`

julia: For evidence packaging, let's do: `evidence-bag.tar.gz` containing `audit/` `configs/` `objects/` `signatures/manifest.sig`. The manifest must be signed with our offline key (GPG) and we should include a SHA512 manifest line for each file.

omar: Good. Add `owner` and `export_tool_version` columns in manifest.csv so assessors can audit provenance. Also include `gpg_key_fingerprint` in top-level metadata file.

trent: KMS/HSM logging fields: timestamp, request_id, principal, operation, key_alias, key_slot (HSM), payload_hash, response_code, trace_id, authorization_hint, duration_ms. Capture both requester IP and user agent if available.

sec-oncall: We'll export CloudTrail + internal audit stream and generate a pre-run sampling report. Retention for the handoff artifacts = 180 days (legal asked for longer).

julia: For retest gating: Critical/P0/P1 must be fixed + validated in our retest environment before scheduling a retest. High/P2 require mitigation + test plan attached. P3/P4 schedule as backlog. Document this in the triage sheet headed by @trent.

omar: One nuance: if a vuln involves KMS key policy or HSM slot config, require `kms_policy_before.json` and `kms_policy_after.json` plus `repro_steps.md`. Also include `patch_diff.patch` where relevant.

julia: Who will perform the GPG signing? I can sign the final manifest but need someone to produce the bag and the presigned URL.

sec-oncall: I'll provision the S3 handoff path: `s3://pt-escrow/acme-20260112/` and create a temporary presigned URL valid for 7 days. Placeholder: `https://presigned.redwood/pt/acme-20260112`

trent: Add tape: we should also produce per-file sha512 and then sign the manifest with our offline key. Example manifest line: `2026-01-12T09:02:11Z,objects/audit/cloudtrail-20260112.ndjson,sha512:7f9c...,102432,audit,julia`

omar: For audit sampling, I'll run these queries ahead of time and include counts.csv so assessors can see what we've already pulled. Example: `jq -c '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="GetObject")' cloudtrail.json > objects/s3-get.ndjson`

julia: Also we need a short exception process for RBAC freeze: `./request-rbac-exception --ticket <URL>` that notifies sec-oncall and requires dual-approval. Keep freeze window to the engagement day only.

sec-oncall: I'll also add a small smoke test endpoint so assessors can invoke `POST /kms-proxy/sign-test` which will produce a logged entry. We'll run that during dry-run.

engsec-bot: Calendar event created: "Partner Pen Test - Acme (staging)" 2026-01-12 09:00 -> 2026-01-13 17:00 UTC. Reminder set.

trent: Dry-run proposed tomorrow 10:30 UTC. Agenda: proxy logging, presigned URL upload, manifest signing, and RBAC exception flow test.

julia: I'll prepare the triage doc and severity mapping. Also I will produce a short `readme.md` inside the evidence bag describing files and how to verify the manifest signature.

omar: I'll provide sample `kms_policy_before.json` and `iam_roles_snapshot.json` for review.

sec-oncall: I'll post runbook link in this thread: `https://go.redwood/runbooks/pen-test-handoff` and the real presigned URL after upload.

julia: Thanks all. Meeting tomorrow 10:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
